## Motivation

Add support for the official [Hy-Nomas](https://huggingface.co/tencent/Hy-Nomas) distilled INT8 DiT and PixelUMM FP8 VAE checkpoints to the existing Nomas pipeline introduced in #46124.

The INT8 DiT stores quantized weights and retains BF16 linear computation. The FP8 VAE uses block-scaled Triton FP8 GEMM.

## Modifications

- Validate official checkpoint metadata, layer manifests, tensor shapes and dtypes before loading.
- Load groupwise INT8 DiT weights through the parallel linear loaders, dequantize in FP32 for BF16 computation, and preserve FP32 scales across component moves.
- Load the FP8 VAE on meta, replace its 180 selected decoder projections, and stream weights through the existing VAE loader.
- Match the official SM89 activation quantization using 128×128 blocks and reuse the existing Triton block FP8 GEMM.
- Let the VAE model declare quantized projections and unused encoder weights while retaining strict decoder validation.
- Extend Nomas tests to cover checkpoint validation, serialization, parallel loading, quantized computation and dtype preservation


## Accuracy Tests

### Demo video

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8d2c514c-c3d8-4c0a-b999-b294f70bdd75



### Real-weight generation and reference comparison

Generated a video through the public DiffGenerator API on one RTX 4090 D with the official INT8 DiT, FP8 VAE and Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct text encoder.

Configuration: 352×640, 40 frames, 24 fps, 8 Euler steps, guidance scale 1, seed 42, structured JSON caption, and CPU offload for all three components.

| Comparison | Result |
|---|---|
| SGLang DiT replay vs. captured pipeline | All 8 predictions bitwise identical; all 775 scales remain FP32 |
| Official DiT vs. SGLang with shared text and main attention implementations | All 8 predictions and final latent bitwise identical |
| Video pixels using each implementation's attention and FP8 GEMM paths | PSNR 26.37 dB; mean SSIM 0.8277 |
| Video pixels with shared DiT attention, Triton vs. official CUTLASS VAE | PSNR 42.64 dB; mean SSIM 0.9920 |
| Video pixels with shared DiT attention and test-only official CUTLASS VAE linears | Bitwise identical |
| Standalone SGLang VAE replay vs. captured pipeline | Bitwise identical |

Pixel metrics are computed before MP4 encoding. PSNR uses raw outputs with data range 2; SSIM uses outputs normalized and clipped to [0, 1]. Shared-backend substitutions are for validation only.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Test with 1 single 4090D, output 40 frames at 24 fps.

Smoke measurement with the configuration above:

| Metric | Result |
|---|---|
| Generation time | 69.52 s |
| Peak allocated GPU memory | 15,317 MiB |
| Peak reserved GPU memory | 16,158 MiB |

This measurement includes component transfers and cold execution. It is not a comparative performance benchmark.

## Motivation

Add support for the official [Hy-Nomas](https://huggingface.co/tencent/Hy-Nomas) distilled INT8 DiT and PixelUMM FP8 VAE checkpoints to the existing Nomas pipeline introduced in #46124.

The INT8 DiT stores quantized weights and retains BF16 linear computation. The FP8 VAE uses block-scaled Triton FP8 GEMM.

## Modifications

- Validate official checkpoint metadata, layer manifests, tensor shapes and dtypes before loading.
- Load groupwise INT8 DiT weights through the parallel linear loaders, dequantize in FP32 for BF16 computation, and preserve FP32 scales across component moves.
- Load the FP8 VAE on meta, replace its 180 selected decoder projections, and stream weights through the existing VAE loader.
- Match the official SM89 activation quantization using 128×128 blocks and reuse the existing Triton block FP8 GEMM.
- Let the VAE model declare quantized projections and unused encoder weights while retaining strict decoder validation.
- Extend Nomas tests to cover checkpoint validation, serialization, parallel loading, quantized computation and dtype preservation


## Accuracy Tests

### Demo video

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8d2c514c-c3d8-4c0a-b999-b294f70bdd75



### Real-weight generation and reference comparison

Generated a video through the public DiffGenerator API on one RTX 4090 D with the official INT8 DiT, FP8 VAE and Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct text encoder.

Configuration: 352×640, 40 frames, 24 fps, 8 Euler steps, guidance scale 1, seed 42, structured JSON caption, and CPU offload for all three components.

| Comparison | Result |
|---|---|
| SGLang DiT replay vs. captured pipeline | All 8 predictions bitwise identical; all 775 scales remain FP32 |
| Official DiT vs. SGLang with shared text and main attention implementations | All 8 predictions and final latent bitwise identical |

| Video pixels with shared DiT attention, Triton vs. official CUTLASS VAE | PSNR 42.64 dB; mean SSIM 0.9920 |
| Video pixels with shared DiT attention and test-only official CUTLASS VAE linears | Bitwise identical |
| Standalone SGLang VAE replay vs. captured pipeline | Bitwise identical |

Pixel metrics are computed before MP4 encoding. PSNR uses raw outputs with data range 2; SSIM uses outputs normalized and clipped to [0, 1]. Shared-backend substitutions are for validation only.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Test with 1 single 4090D, output 40 frames at 24 fps.

Smoke measurement with the configuration above:

| Metric | Result |
|---|---|
| Generation time | 69.52 s |
| Peak allocated GPU memory | 15,317 MiB |
| Peak reserved GPU memory | 16,158 MiB |

This measurement includes component transfers and cold execution. It is not a comparative performance benchmark.

+            compute_dtype=torch.bfloat16,

+        mapper = get_param_names_mapping(param_names_mapping)

+class Fp8Linear(ReplicatedLinear):
+    """Replicated serialized FP8 linear with nn.Linear's tensor return contract."""
+
+    def _apply(self, fn, recurse=True):
+        # Byte views keep serialized FP8 weights and FP32 scales intact while
+        # carrying device/non_blocking semantics through the supplied transform.
+        protected = [
+            parameter
+            for name, parameter in self.named_parameters(recurse=False)
+            if parameter.dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn
+            or name in ("weight_scale", "weight_scale_inv", "input_scale")
+        ]
+
+        def preserve_serialized_dtype(tensor):
+            if any(tensor is parameter for parameter in protected):
+                return fn(tensor.view(torch.uint8)).view(tensor.dtype)
+            return fn(tensor)
+
+        return super()._apply(preserve_serialized_dtype, recurse=recurse)
+
+    def forward(self, x):
+        return super().forward(x)[0]

+                raise ValueError(

+                "weight_dtype": "float8_e4m3fn",
+                "scale_dtype": "float32",
+                "unquantized_float_dtype": "bfloat16",

+def inspect_nomas_int8_checkpoint(path):
+    """Validate all declared tensor headers without reading large weight payloads."""
+    with safe_open(str(path), framework="pt", device="cpu") as reader:
+        metadata = reader.metadata() or {}
+        if metadata.get("format") != INT8_CHECKPOINT_FORMAT:
+            return None
+        for key, expected in (
+            ("group_size", str(GROUP_SIZE)),
+            ("quantization", "symmetric_int8_absmax"),
+            ("compute_dtype", "bfloat16"),
+            ("rounding", "half_away_from_zero"),
+            ("model_type", "HY-Nomas-G/2-32324-MMDiT"),
+        ):
+            if metadata.get(key) != expected:
+                raise ValueError(f"Nomas INT8 checkpoint requires {key}={expected}")
+        try:
+            layers = json.loads(metadata.get("layers", ""))
+        except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Nomas INT8 layers metadata must be a JSON object"
+            ) from exc
+        if not isinstance(layers, dict) or not layers:
+            raise ValueError("Nomas INT8 requires a nonempty layer manifest")
+        keys = set(reader.keys())
+        for suffix in (".weight_q", ".weight_scale"):
+            if {
+                key.removesuffix(suffix) for key in keys if key.endswith(suffix)
+            } != set(layers):
+                raise ValueError(f"Nomas INT8 manifest does not match {suffix} tensors")
+        for name, shape in layers.items():
+            if (
+                not isinstance(name, str)
+                or not name
+                or not isinstance(shape, list)
+                or len(shape) != 2

+            if len(weight_files) != 1:

+            quant_config=quant_config,

+        if type(original) in (ColumnParallelLinear, RowParallelLinear):
